Raising the cap finishes M(2)'s cut samples at Think-SFT's matched-difficulty long-answer rate (~25 %): 234 at 16,384 on this seed plus about 0.25 x ~50 cap hits gives ~246, in line with the other seed going from 232 to 245.

The extra tokens finish Think-SFT's ~62 cut samples per run at ~20-25 %, so singles gain ~13; because three in four late answers are wrong, the vote gains only about a third of that (as on hard328: 238 to 244), so 75 + ~5.

At 16,384 Think-SFT averages 60 of 136 with ~62 cap hits per sample; the theory says those finish right at its matched-difficulty long-answer rate (~20 %, since the fresh tail is hard), which adds about 12.
